description: This file defines a UI component called 'EditorPanel' using LightningJS framework. It manages note editing functionalities such as editing title and content, saving, deleting, and regenerating summaries, with internal state management and user interaction handling.

classes.name: EditorPanel
classes.description: A LightningJS component for editing notes, including title, content, and summary, with associated controls and interactions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current note content to the store.

methods.name: regenerateSummary
methods.description: Generates a new summary from the current content.

methods.name: editTitle
methods.description: Enters editing mode for the title.

methods.name: editContent
methods.description: Enters editing mode for the content.

methods.name: _handleChar
methods.description: Handles character input in edit mode.

methods.name: _handleSpace
methods.description: Handles space input in edit mode.

methods.name: _handleNewline
methods.description: Handles newline input in content edit mode.
